scenes.text: You can literally buy a beautiful, traditional home in Japan right now for absolutely zero dollars because of a massive housing crisis they don't want you to know about.

These abandoned properties, known as Akiya, are piling up because the country's population is shrinking so fast that younger generations are fleeing to crowded cities, leaving millions of countryside homes empty.
To stop these towns from completely dying, local governments are literally giving them away for free, and some will even pay you cash bonuses just to renovate them.
But before you pack your bags, you must deal with strict residency laws, heavy taxes, and rumors of cursed houses, so tell me in the comments if you would actually move here, and hit follow for more!
